title: Navareth Ⅲ - Fantasy Survival
description: Navareth is a medium / hard RP fantasy survival server set in a living world shaped by player action and magic.
body:
Navareth is a medium / hard RP fantasy survival server set in a living world shaped by player action and magic.

- Java Edition - Neoforge 1.21.1
- Medium Roleplay
- Survival focused fantasy gameplay
- Spell Engine and Iron's Spells n' Spellbooks for magic
- RPG series for classes
- Create: Aeronautics for exploration

Whether you are a wizard, knight, king, or merchant, Navareth is a world where your choices matter and your story leaves a mark.
